trap.label: discurso indireto (recuo)
trap.wrong: He said me that he is tired. She told that she will call.
trap.right: He told me that he was tired. She said that she would call.
trap.why: Em português “disse que está cansado” mantém o presente e “disse a mim” aceita dizer. Em inglês, tell leva pessoa; say não; e o verbo recua (is → was, will → would).

mcq.q: “I am tired.” → He said that he ___ tired.
“I will call.” → She said she ___ call.
He ___ me that he was busy.
